# SpikingStateEstimation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method for estimating dynamical system states using spike-based neural coding and temporal dynamics, rather than continuous-valued computations. Facilitates ultra-low-power, asynchronous state estimation suitable for in-network neuromorphic processors, reducing latency and energy overhead.
